Write the owner's words, with the time, as one unused answer in ~/.construct-owner/answers, the channel an owner decision is accepted from (construct say v<version>)

USAGE construct say [OPTIONS] [WORDS]

ARGUMENTS

  WORDS    The owner's words, quoted as one argument

OPTIONS

   --plain    No colors, no lore (CI-friendly) (Default: false)
  --johnny    Wake up, Netrunner. (Default: false)
